full_thread.body:
Hi,

I'm CTO at RelayMind. We prototyped our support triage on byLLM last month and it outperformed our hand-rolled pipeline on both accuracy and cost.

We'd like to explore a deeper integration and possibly a partnership - co-marketing, or at minimum a case study. Who is the right person to talk to, and would you have time for a call in the next two weeks?

Chris Tanaka
CTO, RelayMind

key_points_to_address: thank him and express interest in the partnership conversation
answer the who-to-talk-to question or offer to be the contact
respond to the call request with availability in the next two weeks

emails.subject: Bug: edge traversal returns duplicates after node delete (repro attached)
emails.snippet: Hi team, we hit a bug in production: after deleting a node, [-->] traversal from its former neighbors returns duplicate edges. Repro: create A-B-C chain, delete B, traverse from A. On 0.10.2 this

full_thread.body:
Hi team,

We hit a bug in production: after deleting a node, [-->] traversal from its former neighbors returns duplicate edges.

Repro (Jac 0.10.2):
1. Create nodes A, B, C with edges A->B, B->C
2. Delete node B
3. Traverse [-->] from A - returns two stale edge references

Is this a known issue? Is there a workaround we can ship while a fix lands? Happy to file a GitHub issue with the full snippet if useful.

Omar Said
Nexus Analytica

key_points_to_address: thank him for the clear reproduction steps
acknowledge the bug report and say it will be investigated
ask him to file the GitHub issue (or commit to filing it) so it can be tracked

full_thread.body:
Hi,

I'm a reporter at TechLedger writing a piece on the rise of agent-native programming languages, publishing Thursday.

Could someone from Jaseci give a 2-3 sentence quote on why general-purpose languages fall short for agentic software? My deadline is August 5 EOD Eastern.

Thanks,
Grace Liu
TechLedger

key_points_to_address: provide (or commit to providing) the requested 2-3 sentence quote
keep the quote on-topic: why agent-native languages vs general-purpose ones
labels.edge_case: deadline_pressure: the reply must land before a hard next-day deadline, so deferring without the quote is a weak response

web_search_results.agentic programming: Agent-native programming languages build agent concepts (autonomous traversal, typed LLM delegation, persistent graph state) into the language itself, rather than layering them on via libraries; proponents argue this reduces glue code and makes agent behavior statically checkable.
web_search_results.gsoc: Google Summer of Code is an annual program where contributors work on open-source projects with mentoring organizations; newcomers are typically directed to good-first-issue labels and community channels before the application window.
